question: Diesel fuel is generally used in which of the following types of vehicles?
solution:
The correct answer is __Heavy trucks and buses****.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Diesel fuel__ is primarily used in heavy vehicles due to its high energy efficiency and torque capabilities.
 
• Heavy trucks and buses require engines that generate more torque for hauling and transportation.
 
• Diesel engines are known for their durability and fuel economy in long-distance travel.
 
• They are widely used in freight transportation and public transit systems.
 
• Compared to gasoline engines, diesel engines emit less carbon monoxide but may produce more particulate matter.
 
• Diesel engines are also employed in construction and agricultural machinery due to their reliability in heavy-duty tasks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Scooters:**
 
 
• Scooters typically use petrol as fuel due to their small engine size.
 
• They are designed for light commuting rather than heavy-duty tasks.
 
 
 
• **Aerospace vehicles:**
 
 
• Aerospace vehicles primarily use specialized fuels such as aviation gasoline (AvGas) or jet fuel.
 
• These fuels are designed for high-altitude and high-speed operations.
 
 
 
• **Cars:**
 
 
• Passenger cars typically use petrol or diesel depending on the engine type.
 
• Diesel is more common in larger cars and SUVs for better fuel efficiency.
